ClassicPage = TabClassic.Page

    ClassicPage.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    ClassicPage.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    ClassicPage.ScrollBarThickness = 2
    ClassicPage.ScrollingEnabled = true
    ClassicPage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ClassicPage:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")

    local classicScripts = LoadClassicManifest()
    local CL = {holders = {}}

    CL.hero = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = ClassicPage,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 92),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 9,
    })
    CL.hero:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
    corner(CL.hero, 16)
    stroke(CL.hero, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.55)
    CL.emblem = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = CL.hero,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, -30),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.8,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 10,
    })
    CL.emblem:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
    corner(CL.emblem, 18)
    local emblemRing = stroke(CL.emblem, Theme.Accent, 1.5, 0.3)
    emblemRing:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
    mk("ImageLabel", {
        Parent = CL.emblem,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -19, 0.5, -19),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Image = "rbxassetid://99086270459218",
        ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
        ZIndex = 11,
    })
    CL.title = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = CL.hero,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 24),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 88, 0, 14),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "Classic",
        TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
        TextSize = 20,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex = 10,
    })
    CL.title:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
    CL.sub = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = CL.hero,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 14),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 88, 0, 38),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = GetText("Scripts clásicos de Yin Yang · tocá uno para cargarlo", "Classic Yin Yang scripts · tap one to load it"),
        TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextSize = 10,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        ZIndex = 10,
    })
    CL.sub:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
    CL.sub:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Scripts clásicos de Yin Yang · tocá uno para cargarlo")
    CL.sub:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Classic Yin Yang scripts · tap one to load it")
    CL.chips = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = CL.hero,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 20),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 88, 0, 58),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ZIndex = 10,
    })
    mk("UIListLayout", {Parent = CL.chips, FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})
    function CL.chip(order, role)
        local c = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = CL.chips,
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme[role],
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.8,
            Text = "",
            TextColor3 = Theme[role],
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
            TextSize = 10,
            LayoutOrder = order,
            ZIndex = 11,
        })
        c:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", role)
        c:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", role)
        c:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        corner(c, 999)
        mk("UIPadding", {Parent = c, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9)})
        return c
    end
    CL.countChip = CL.chip(1, "Accent")
    CL.activeChip = CL.chip(2, "ToggleOn")

    CL.searchHolder = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = ClassicPage,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 9,
    })
    CL.searchHolder:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
    corner(CL.searchHolder, 12)
    local searchStroke = stroke(CL.searchHolder, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.6)
    RowKit.IconAt(CL.searchHolder, 100388562921803, 16, UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -8), 10, "TextDim")
    CL.search = mk("TextBox", {
        Parent = CL.searchHolder,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
        PlaceholderText = GetText("Buscar script...", "Search script..."),
        PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
        TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextSize = 12,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ClearTextOnFocus = false,
        ZIndex = 10,
    })
    CL.search:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
    CL.search:SetAttribute("PlaceholderSpanish", "Buscar script...")
    CL.search:SetAttribute("PlaceholderEnglish", "Search script...")
    CL.search.Focused:Connect(function()
        searchStroke.Color = Theme.Accent
        searchStroke.Transparency = 0.1
    end)
    CL.search.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        searchStroke.Color = Theme.Stroke
        searchStroke.Transparency = 0.6
    end)

    CL.empty = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = ClassicPage,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
        TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextSize = 12,
        TextWrapped = true,
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = 9,
    })
    CL.empty:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")

    function CL.refresh()
        local active = 0
        for _, h in ipairs(CL.holders) do
            local st = h.holder:GetAttribute("ScriptState")
            if st == "active" or st == "loading" then active = active + 1 end
        end
        CL.countChip.Text = GetText(#CL.holders .. " scripts", #CL.holders .. " scripts")
        CL.activeChip.Text = GetText(active .. " activos", active .. " active")
    end

    function CL.filter()
        local q = string.lower(CL.search.Text or "")
        local shown = 0
        for _, h in ipairs(CL.holders) do
            local match = q == "" or string.find(h.es, q, 1, true) ~= nil or string.find(h.en, q, 1, true) ~= nil
            h.holder.Visible = match
            if match then shown = shown + 1 end
        end
        if #CL.holders == 0 then
            CL.empty.Text = GetText("No se pudo cargar la lista de scripts.", "Could not load the script list.")
            CL.empty.Visible = true
        elseif shown == 0 then
            CL.empty.Text = GetText("Ningún script coincide con la búsqueda.", "No script matches your search.")
            CL.empty.Visible = true
        else
            CL.empty.Visible = false
        end
    end
    CL.search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(CL.filter)

    for _, entry in ipairs(classicScripts) do
        if type(entry) == "table" and entry.es and entry.en and entry.file and entry.key then
            local holder = TabClassic:CreateScriptToggle(
                tostring(entry.es),
                tostring(entry.en),
                entry.url and tostring(entry.url) or CLASSIC_SCRIPT_URL,
                tostring(entry.key)
            )
            if holder then
                table.insert(CL.holders, {holder = holder, es = string.lower(tostring(entry.es)), en = string.lower(tostring(entry.en))})
                holder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ScriptState"):Connect(CL.refresh)
            end
        else
            warn("[YinYang Classic] Entrada de manifest inválida; se omite")
        end
    end
    CL.refresh()
    CL.filter()
    end
    Window:CreateClassicTab()

    function Window:CreateSpotifyTab()
    local STab = Window:CreateTab("Spotify", "Spotify", "rbxassetid://97213700655604")
    local SPage = STab.Page

    SPage.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    SPage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    SPage.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
    SPage.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    SPage.ScrollBarThickness = 0
    SPage.ScrollingEnabled = false

    -- La portada se presenta como una capa temporal: no modifica ni guarda el tema.
    do
        local A = {Active = false, Token = 0, Cover = "", Cache = {}, SavedText = {}}
        Window._SpotifyAmbient = A

        local function tween(obj, values, duration)
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                local ok, tw = pcall(function()
                    return TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(duration or 0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), values)
                end)
                if ok and tw then tw:Play() end
            end
        end

        function A.makeLayer(parent, z, size)
            local frame = mk("Frame", {
                Name = "SpotifyAmbient", Parent = parent, Size = size,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false,
                Visible = false, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = z,
            })
            corner(frame, 10)
            local image = mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = frame, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = "", ImageTransparency = 1, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
                Active = false, ZIndex = z,
            })
            corner(image, 10)
            local shade = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = frame, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(7, 7, 10),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, ZIndex = z,
            })
            corner(shade, 10)
            return {Frame = frame, Image = image, Shade = shade}
        end

        A.Top = A.makeLayer(TopBar, 6, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1))
        -- Debajo de la lista para que el desplazamiento y los toques sigan funcionando.
        A.Side = A.makeLayer(Body, 6, UDim2.new(0, 128, 1, 0))
        local compactRail = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactTabRail")
        if compactRail then A.Compact = A.makeLayer(compactRail, 16, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)) end
        A.Layers = {A.Top, A.Side}
        if A.Compact then table.insert(A.Layers, A.Compact) end

        function A.rememberText(obj)
            if obj and obj.Parent and (obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox")) then
                if A.SavedText[obj] == nil then A.SavedText[obj] = obj.TextColor3 end
                tween(obj, {TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(250, 250, 250)}, 0.22)
            end
        end

        function A.paintTabs(color)
            if not A.Active then return end
            for strokeObject in pairs(A.SavedStrokes or {}) do
                if strokeObject.Parent then tween(strokeObject, {Color = color}, 0.24) end
            end
            for _, tab in ipairs(Window.Tabs or {}) do
                A.rememberText(tab.NameLabel)
                if tab.Button and tab.Button.Parent then
                    local selected = tab.Page and tab.Page.Visible
                    tween(tab.Button, {
                        BackgroundColor3 = selected and color or Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12),
                        BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0.35 or 1,
                    }, 0.24)
                end
                if tab.CompactButton and tab.CompactButton.Parent then
                    local selected = tab.Page and tab.Page.Visible
                    tween(tab.CompactButton, {
                        BackgroundColor3 = selected and color or Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12),
                        BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0.3 or 0.7,
                    }, 0.24)
                    A.rememberText(tab.CompactButton:FindFirstChild("Fallback"))
                end
            end
        end

        -- EditableImage no siempre tiene permiso para leer una portada; el fondo
        -- sigue usando la imagen real y se usa un acento neutro si no se puede.
        function A.sample(cover, token)
            if A.Cache[cover] then return A.Cache[cover] end
            if type(Content) ~= "table" or type(buffer) ~= "table" or cover == "" then return nil end
            local image
            local ok, result = pcall(function()
                image = game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateEditableImageAsync(Content.fromUri(cover))
                if not image then return nil end
                local size = image.Size
                if size.X <= 0 or size.Y <= 0 then return nil end
                local r, g, b, weight = 0, 0, 0, 0
                for y = 0, 5 do
                    for x = 0, 5 do
                        if token ~= A.Token then return nil end
                        local px = math.clamp(math.floor((x + 0.5) * size.X / 6), 0, size.X - 1)
                        local py = math.clamp(math.floor((y + 0.5) * size.Y / 6), 0, size.Y - 1)
                        local bytes = image:ReadPixelsBuffer(Vector2.new(px, py), Vector2.new(1, 1))
                        local rr, gg, bb = buffer.readu8(bytes, 0), buffer.readu8(bytes, 1), buffer.readu8(bytes, 2)
                        local alpha = buffer.readu8(bytes, 3) / 255
                        local brightness = math.max(rr, gg, bb) / 255
                        local saturation = (math.max(rr, gg, bb) - math.min(rr, gg, bb)) / 255
                        local w = alpha * (0.3 + saturation) * math.clamp(brightness * 2, 0.12, 1)
                        r, g, b, weight = r + rr * w, g + gg * w, b + bb * w, weight + w
                    end
                end
                if weight <= 0 then return nil end
                return Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(r / weight), math.floor(g / weight), math.floor(b / weight))
            end)
            if image then pcall(function() image:Destroy() end) end
            if not ok or not result then return nil end
            local h, s = Color3.toHSV(result)
            local color = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.clamp(s, 0, 0.8), 0.36)
            A.Cache[cover] = color
            return color
        end

        function A.updateLayers(cover, token)
            local tint = A.Cache[cover] or Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 40)
            A.paintTabs(tint)
            for _, layer in ipairs(A.Layers) do
                layer.Frame.Visible = true
                tween(layer.Frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.08, BackgroundColor3 = tint}, 0.28)
                tween(layer.Shade, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.48}, 0.28)
                tween(layer.Image, {ImageTransparency = 1}, 0.14)
            end
            A.Side.Frame.Visible = TabList.Visible
            task.delay(0.15, function()
                if token ~= A.Token or not A.Active then return end
                for _, layer in ipairs(A.Layers) do
                    layer.Image.Image = cover
                    tween(layer.Image, {ImageTransparency = cover ~= "" and 0.12 or 1}, 0.32)
                end
            end)
            if cover ~= "" and not A.Cache[cover] then
                task.spawn(function()
                    local color = A.sample(cover, token)
                    if color and A.Active and token == A.Token then
                        A.paintTabs(color)
                        for _, layer in ipairs(A.Layers) do tween(layer.Frame, {BackgroundColor3 = color}, 0.3) end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        function A.SetCover(cover)
            cover = type(cover) == "string" and cover or ""
            if A.Cover == cover then return end
            A.Cover = cover
            if A.Active then
                A.Token = A.Token + 1
                A.updateLayers(cover, A.Token)
            end
        end

        function A.enter()
            if A.Active then return end
            A.Active = true
            A.ThemeAtEntry = Window.CurrentTheme
            A.TabListTransparency = TabList.BackgroundTransparency
            A.Token = A.Token + 1
            A.SavedText = {}
            A.SavedStrokes = {}
            for _, parent in ipairs({Main, TitleDivider}) do
                local border = parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if border then A.SavedStrokes[border] = border.Color end
            end
            for _, obj in ipairs(TopBar:GetDescendants()) do A.rememberText(obj) end
            A.rememberText(TitleLabel)
            tween(TabList, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}, 0.28)
            A.updateLayers(A.Cover, A.Token)
        end

        function A.leave()
            if not A.Active then return end
            A.Active = false
            A.Token = A.Token + 1
            local token = A.Token
            local listTransparency = A.TabListTransparency
            if A.ThemeAtEntry ~= Window.CurrentTheme then
                listTransparency = Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0
            end
            tween(TabList, {BackgroundTransparency = listTransparency or 0}, 0.3)
            for _, layer in ipairs(A.Layers) do
                tween(layer.Frame, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}, 0.3)
                tween(layer.Image, {ImageTransparency = 1}, 0.3)
                tween(layer.Shade, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}, 0.3)
            end
            for obj, color in pairs(A.SavedText) do
                if obj and obj.Parent then
                    local role = obj:GetAttribute("ThemeTextRole")
                    if A.ThemeAtEntry ~= Window.CurrentTheme and role and Theme[role] then color = Theme[role] end
                    tween(obj, {TextColor3 = color}, 0.22)
                end
            end
            A.SavedText = {}
            for border, color in pairs(A.SavedStrokes or {}) do
                if border and border.Parent then
                    if A.ThemeAtEntry ~= Window.CurrentTheme then color = Theme.Border or Theme.Accent end
                    tween(border, {Color = color}, 0.22)
                end
            end
            A.SavedStrokes = {}
            for _, tab in ipairs(Window.Tabs or {}) do
                if tab.Button and tab.Button.Parent then
                    local selected = tab.Page and tab.Page.Visible
                    tween(tab.Button, {
                        BackgroundColor3 = selected and Theme.TabActive or Theme.Background,
                        BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0 or (Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0),
                    }, 0.22)
                end
            end
            if Window._RefreshCompactNavigation then Window._RefreshCompactNavigation() end
            task.delay(0.32, function()
                if A.Token ~= token or A.Active then return end
                for _, layer in ipairs(A.Layers) do layer.Frame.Visible = false end
            end)
        end

        track(SPage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
            task.defer(function()
                if not SPage.Parent then return end
                if SPage.Visible then A.enter() else A.leave() end
            end)
        end))
        track(TabList:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
            if A.Active then A.Side.Frame.Visible = TabList.Visible end
        end))
        if SPage.Visible then A.enter() end
    end


    local SPOTIFY_CATALOG_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nbritez672-tech/Yin-music/refs/heads/main/YinYang_Spotify_Catalog.lua"

    local function asset(id)
        return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
    end

    local function trim(s)
        return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
    end

    local function clamp(v, minV, maxV)
        if v < minV then return minV end
        if v > maxV then return maxV end
        return v
    end

    local function durationToSeconds(duration)
        if type(duration) == "number" then
            return math.max(0, math.floor(duration))
        end

        local text = trim(duration)
        if text == "" then
            return 0
        end

        local mm, ss = text:match("^(%d+):(%d+)$")
        if mm and ss then
            return tonumber(mm) * 60 + tonumber(ss)
        end

        local numeric = tonumber(text)
        return numeric and math.max(0, math.floor(numeric)) or 0
    end

    local function secondsToClock(seconds)
        seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(seconds) or 0))
        local mm = math.floor(seconds / 60)
        local ss = seconds % 60
        return string.format("%d:%02d", mm, ss)
    end

    local function safeDestroy(instance)
        if instance then
            pcall(function()
                instance:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end

    local function destroyAllSpotifySounds()
        local function clean(parent)
            if not parent then
                return
            end
            for _, inst in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
                if inst:IsA("Sound") and inst.Name == "YY_Spotify_CurrentSound" then
                    pcall(function()
                        inst:Stop()
                    end)
                    safeDestroy(inst)
                end
            end
        end

        clean(workspace)
        if game:GetService("SoundService") then
            clean(game:GetService("SoundService"))
        end
    end

    local function normalizeTrack(track, index)
        if type(track) ~= "table" then
            return nil
        end

        local name = track.Name or track.name or track.Title or track.title or ("Track " .. tostring(index))
        local artist = track.Artist or track.artist or ""
        local duration = track.Duration or track.duration or "0:00"
        if type(duration) == "number" then
            duration = secondsToClock(duration)
        else
            duration = trim(duration)
            if duration == "" then
                duration = "0:00"
            end
        end

        local cover = track.Cover or track.cover or track.CoverId or track.coverId or track.coverUrl or ""
        local coverDownloadUrl = track.CoverURL or track.coverURL or track.CoverUrl or ""
        local audioUrl = track.AudioURL or track.audioUrl or track.AudioUrl or track.audioURL or ""

        local safeName = tostring(name):lower():gsub("[^%w]+", "_"):gsub("_+", "_"):gsub("^_", ""):gsub("_$", "")
        if safeName == "" then
            safeName = "track_" .. tostring(index)
        end

        local cacheName = track.CacheName or track.cacheName or track.audioFile or track.AudioFile
        if not cacheName or trim(cacheName) == "" then
            cacheName = safeName .. ".mp3"
        end

        local coverCacheName = track.CoverCacheName or track.coverCacheName or ""
        if trim(coverDownloadUrl) ~= "" and trim(coverCacheName) == "" then
            local urlWithoutQuery = tostring(coverDownloadUrl):match("^[^%?#]+") or tostring(coverDownloadUrl)
            local urlExt = urlWithoutQuery:match("%.([%w]+)$")
            urlExt = (urlExt and urlExt ~= "" and #urlExt <= 5) and urlExt:lower() or "png"
            coverCacheName = safeName .. "_cover." .. urlExt
        end

        local id = track.Id or track.id or track.ID or tostring(index)

        return {
            Id = id,
            Name = tostring(name),
            Artist = tostring(artist),
            Duration = duration,
            Cover = tostring(cover),
            CoverURL = tostring(coverDownloadUrl),
            CoverCacheName = tostring(coverCacheName),
            AudioURL = tostring(audioUrl),
            CacheName = tostring(cacheName),
            IsUserSong = track.IsUserSong == true,
            Raw = track,
        }
    end

    local SpotifyState = {
        Catalog = {},
        SelectedIndex = 1,
        IsPlaying = false,
        IsRepeat = false,
        CurrentLiked = {},
        RowButtons = {},
        HiddenRows = {},
        CurrentSound = nil,
        SoundProgressConnection = nil,
        SoundEndedConnection = nil,
        CurrentTrack = nil,
        CurrentTrackSeconds = 0,
        CurrentPausedPosition = 0,
        CatalogLoaded = false,
        SearchQuery = "",
        PlaybackVolume = 0.75,
        PlaybackSpeed = 1,
        SettingsMenuVisible = false,
        FloatingPlayerVisible = false,
        FavoritesView = false,
        MySongsView = false,
        UserSongs = {},
    }

    local refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer = function() end
    local refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu = function() end

    local function getRenderOrder()
        local order = {}
        for i = 1, #SpotifyState.Catalog do
            order[#order + 1] = i
        end

        table.sort(order, function(a, b)
            local likedA = SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[a] == true
            local likedB = SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[b] == true
            if likedA ~= likedB then
                return likedA and not likedB
            end
            return a < b
        end)

        return order
    end


    local function normalizeSearchText(value)
        local s = tostring(value or "")
        local replacements = {
            ["á"] = "a", ["à"] = "a", ["ä"] = "a", ["â"] = "a", ["ã"] = "a", ["å"] = "a",
            ["Á"] = "a", ["À"] = "a", ["Ä"] = "a", ["Â"] = "a", ["Ã"] = "a", ["Å"] = "a",
            ["é"] = "e", ["è"] = "e", ["ë"] = "e", ["ê"] = "e",
            ["É"] = "e", ["È"] = "e", ["Ë"] = "e", ["Ê"] = "e",
            ["í"] = "i", ["ì"] = "i", ["ï"] = "i", ["î"] = "i",
            ["Í"] = "i", ["Ì"] = "i", ["Ï"] = "i", ["Î"] = "i",
            ["ó"] = "o", ["ò"] = "o", ["ö"] = "o", ["ô"] = "o", ["õ"] = "o",
            ["Ó"] = "o", ["Ò"] = "o", ["Ö"] = "o", ["Ô"] = "o", ["Õ"] = "o",
            ["ú"] = "u", ["ù"] = "u", ["ü"] = "u", ["û"] = "u",
            ["Ú"] = "u", ["Ù"] = "u", ["Ü"] = "u", ["Û"] = "u",
            ["ñ"] = "n", ["Ñ"] = "n",
            ["ç"] = "c", ["Ç"] = "c",
        }
        for from, to in pairs(replacements) do
            s = s:gsub(from, to)
        end
        s = s:lower()
        s = trim(s)
        return s
    end

    local function getVisibleRenderOrder()
        local query = normalizeSearchText(SpotifyState.SearchQuery or "")
        local order = getRenderOrder()
        local filtered = {}

        for _, index in ipairs(order) do
            local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
            local matchesView = true
            if SpotifyState.MySongsView then
                matchesView = track ~= nil and track.IsUserSong == true
            elseif SpotifyState.FavoritesView then
                matchesView = SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[index] == true
            end
            if matchesView then
                filtered[#filtered + 1] = index
            end
        end

        if query == "" then
            return filtered
        end

        local tokens = {}
        for token in query:gmatch("%S+") do
            tokens[#tokens + 1] = token
        end

        table.clear(filtered)
        for _, index in ipairs(order) do
            local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
            if SpotifyState.MySongsView and (not track or track.IsUserSong ~= true) then
                continue
            end
            if not SpotifyState.MySongsView and SpotifyState.FavoritesView and SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[index] ~= true then
                continue
            end
            if track then
                local haystack = normalizeSearchText((track.Name or "") .. " " .. (track.Artist or "") .. " " .. (track.Duration or ""))
                local matched = true

                for _, token in ipairs(tokens) do
                    if not haystack:find(token, 1, true) then
                        matched = false
                        break
                    end
                end

                if matched then
                    filtered[#filtered + 1] = index
                end
            end
        end
        return filtered
    end

    local spotifyGreen = Color3.fromRGB(29, 185, 84)
    local spotifyText = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245)
    local spotifyDim = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)

    local spotifyPanel = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)

    local function getSpotifyMetrics()
        local width = 0
        pcall(function()
            width = (SPage and SPage.AbsoluteSize and SPage.AbsoluteSize.X) or 0
        end)

        local compact = width > 0 and width < 640
        local gridColumns = 3
        local gridGapX = width > 0 and (width < 420 and 8 or 12) or 10
        local gridGapY = width > 0 and (width < 420 and 12 or 16) or 12
        local cardHeight = width > 0 and (width < 420 and 228 or 242) or 228

        return {
            compact = compact,
            playerHeight = compact and 200 or 220,
            albumSize = compact and 130 or 150,
            albumTop = compact and 32 or 36,
            infoLeft = compact and 154 or 174,
            infoWidth = compact and -172 or -192,
            titleSize = compact and 20 or 22,
            artistSize = compact and 13 or 14,
            metaSize = compact and 10 or 11,
            progressBottom = compact and -30 or -34,
            controlsBottom = compact and -46 or -52,
            controlsHeight = compact and 40 or 44,
            repeatX = compact and 0.06 or 0.05,
            likeX = compact and 0.15 or 0.14,
            playX = compact and 0.59 or 0.58,
            nextX = compact and 0.85 or 0.87,
            moreX = compact and 0.95 or 0.96,
            playSize = compact and 30 or 34,
            rowHeight = compact and 64 or 70,
            rowCover = compact and 44 or 50,
            rowTitleSize = compact and 14 or 15,
            rowArtistSize = compact and 10 or 11,
            rowDurationSize = compact and 10 or 11,
            rowTitleRight = compact and -154 or -184,
            rowDurationX = compact and -128 or -150,
            rowPlusX = compact and -76 or -92,
            rowPlayX = compact and -34 or -42,
            gridColumns = gridColumns,
            cardHeight = cardHeight,
            gridGapY = gridGapY,
            gridGapX = gridGapX,
        }
    end

    local SongList, SongListLayout

    local function updateSpotifyCanvas()
        SPage.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    end

    local function updateSongListCanvas()
        local contentY = 0
        pcall(function()
            contentY = SongListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y
        end)

        local rowCount = #SpotifyState.RowButtons
        if contentY <= 0 and rowCount > 0 then
            local m = getSpotifyMetrics()
            local columns = m.gridColumns
            local rows = math.ceil(rowCount / columns)
            contentY = (rows * m.cardHeight) + math.max(0, (rows - 1) * m.gridGapY)
        end

        SongList.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, math.max(0, math.floor(contentY + 16)))
    end

    SeekHitbox = mk("TextButton", {
        Parent = NowPlayingCard,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 28),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 295),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        ZIndex = 22,
    })

    isSeeking = false
    local seekInput = nil

    local spotifySwipe = {
        input = nil,
        start = nil,
        moved = false,
        threshold = 24,
    }

    track(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            return
        end
        local pos = SpotifyShell.AbsolutePosition
        local size = SpotifyShell.AbsoluteSize
        if input.Position.X < pos.X or input.Position.X > pos.X + size.X
            or input.Position.Y < pos.Y or input.Position.Y > pos.Y + size.Y then
            return
        end
        local seekPos = SeekHitbox.AbsolutePosition
        local seekSize = SeekHitbox.AbsoluteSize
        if input.Position.X >= seekPos.X and input.Position.X <= seekPos.X + seekSize.X
            and input.Position.Y >= seekPos.Y and input.Position.Y <= seekPos.Y + seekSize.Y then
            return
        end
        spotifySwipe.input = input
        spotifySwipe.start = input.Position
        spotifySwipe.moved = false
    end))

    track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not spotifySwipe.input or not spotifySwipe.start then
            return
        end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            return
        end
        local delta = input.Position - spotifySwipe.start
        if math.abs(delta.X) >= spotifySwipe.threshold and math.abs(delta.X) > math.abs(delta.Y) * 1.15 then
            spotifySwipe.moved = true
        end
    end))

    track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if not spotifySwipe.input or not spotifySwipe.start then
            return
        end
        if input ~= spotifySwipe.input and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            return
        end

        local delta = input.Position - spotifySwipe.start
        local horizontal = math.abs(delta.X)
        local vertical = math.abs(delta.Y)
        if not isSeeking and not SpotifyState.BlockSwipe and (spotifySwipe.moved or (horizontal >= spotifySwipe.threshold and horizontal > vertical * 1.15)) then
            if delta.X < 0 then
                SpotifyPages:Next()
            else
                SpotifyPages:Previous()
            end
        end

        spotifySwipe.input = nil
        spotifySwipe.start = nil
        spotifySwipe.moved = false
    end))

    local function getSeekPercent(inputX)
        local trackPos = ProgressTrack.AbsolutePosition.X
        local trackWidth = ProgressTrack.AbsoluteSize.X
        if trackWidth <= 0 then return 0 end
        return math.clamp((inputX - trackPos) / trackWidth, 0, 1)
    end

    local function applySeekVisuals(pct)
        SeekThumb.Position = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 0.5, 0)
        SeekTooltip.Position = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 0, -8)
        local total = 0
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound and SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimeLength > 0 then
            total = SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimeLength
        elseif SpotifyState.CurrentTrack then
            total = durationToSeconds(SpotifyState.CurrentTrack.Duration)
        end
        local seekSec = math.floor(pct * math.max(total, 1))
        SeekTooltipLabel.Text = secondsToClock(seekSec)
    end

    SeekHitbox.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        isSeeking = true
        seekInput = input
        SeekThumb.Visible = true
        SeekTooltip.Visible = true
        local pct = getSeekPercent(input.Position.X)
        applySeekVisuals(pct)
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not isSeeking then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        local pct = getSeekPercent(input.Position.X)
        applySeekVisuals(pct)
        ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if not isSeeking then return end
        if input ~= seekInput then return end
        isSeeking = false
        seekInput = nil
        SeekThumb.Visible = false
        SeekTooltip.Visible = false
        local pct = getSeekPercent(input.Position.X)
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            pcall(function()
                local total = SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimeLength
                if total > 0 then
                    local newPos = pct * total
                    SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition = newPos
                    SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = newPos
                    if SpotifyState.IsPlaying then
                        SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Play()
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
